author: Coco_stag
body:
Hello, 
This may sound stupid, because 30 days is a while but I'll see your opinions. Honestly, if someone has an inappropriate name they shouldn't be able to ban evade, even thought the account they ban evaded on doesn't have an inappropriate name. My reasoning for this is because it was their dumb ass fault for changing the name so why should they have the right to play? They should wait the 30 days, so they have learnt their lesson. Please, consider this and not let all the suggestions go to pure shit.
-Rilo

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
The reason why we temp-ban for 30 days is so that they can change their name before they come back.
(because Mojang only allows a name change once every 30 days that's why we tb for 30 days)

The reason why we allowed players to ban evade this punishment is because their other account(s) (normally) have appropriate names, so why should we punish them when their second account no longer violates this rule?

Punishing users for ban evading inappropriate username punishments literally doesn't make sense.

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
The username on the secondary account doesn't violate any rules.
The reason why the first account was banned was because the name was offensive. Whereas the second account's name is no longer offensive, so why would we continue to punish the player?

It's different when compared to Hacked Clients because when a user ban evades, we are not sure whether or not they'll hacek again (which is why we permanently ban ban evaders).

But when it comes to names, we know 100% that they won't break the rules again. Because their name is no longer innappropriate. 
(Unless they change their name to something rude in which case, they'll get punished)
